forecast-period.text: A high pressure system west of the Bight extends a ridge over SA. The high moves through the Bight on Thursday and over the eastern states on Friday, as a cold front clips the southeast on Friday. Another high pressure system moves over waters to the south of SA over the weekend. A developing low pressure system over WA moves closer to the border with SA on the weekend.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.
Possible light morning showers about windward coast and ranges. Maximum temperatures below average. Generally southwest to southeasterly winds, fresh and gusty in the northeast during the morning.
Light showers about southern coasts. Fresh and gusty southwest to southerly winds, strong at times about coastal parts.

Possible morning fog patches about Eyre Peninsula. Showers about windward coasts, extending across the southern agricultural area during the afternoon and evening. Possible showers or thunderstorms developing about the far west late. Maximum temperatures below average about central and eastern districts, grading to above average in the west. Light winds, shifting north to northwesterly ahead of a fresh southwest to southeasterly change extending throughout during the afternoon and evening.

Possible light morning showers about the agricultural area. Possible showers or thunderstorms in the west. Maximum temperatures above average in the northwest and far north grading to below average elsewhere. Moderate to fresh southwest to southeasterly winds, shifting east to northeasterly in the west.

text.p: Possible showers or thunderstorms in the west. Maximum temperatures above average in the west and far north grading to below average elsewhere. Moderate to fresh southeast to northeasterly winds, shifting northwest to southwesterly in the far west.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Sunday: Less than 2 mm about the northern agricultural area increasing to 2 to 5 mm across the southern agricultural area and in the west, with possible falls of 5 to 10 mm about the Lower South East district.
